question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Q is an immediate neighbour of both B and C. A is sitting second to the left of C. P is sitting second to the right of Q. R is immediate neighbour of both A and C. Who is an immediate neighbour of both A and B?
solution: **Given:** Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) A is sitting second to the left of C. 2) R is immediate neighbour of both A and C.
